title: Isaac Sacrificed
intro: Akedah (Hebrew: 'the binding') is the story of Abraham's test when God asked him to sacrifice Isaac. It is one of the Bible's most dramatic narratives - and a powerful image of God the Father sacrificing His own Son.

items.title: The promises confirmed with an oath

footer.title: Christ in the Akedah
footer.content: The entire story points to Christ: Isaac is the beloved son, carries the wood for his own sacrifice, and is laid on the altar at Moria - where the temple later stood, near Golgotha. But while Abraham received his son back, God gave His own Son for us.
